# Server Maintenance Notice

Dear Doctor，
We will conduct server maintenance on UTC 2026/3/5 07:00. The maintenance is expected to take 1 hour.

Main updates include:
1. New Raven special effect gear:
Heart of Wisdom, Feather of The Night, Sharp Beak reaching designated levels will activate the Night Raven Mask.
Tail of Wind, Attacker's Claw, Eye of Perception reaching designated levels will activate the Raven Feather Cloak.

2. Optimized city building layout:
Warrior Statue, Warlock Statue, Ranger Statue have been merged into an independent Temple building (countructable after the maintenance). A new Hall of Honor (countructable after the maintenance) has been added to display Heroes' honor levels.
Merged Research Lab 1 and Research Lab 2, now both research queues enjoy optimal Speedup Buff. New functional buildings will be constructed on the vacated land.

3. Optimized Research UI to improve experience (does not affect your current research progress or stats).

4. Optimized Monthly Pass effects:
Improved: Gathering Speedup 10% → 15%
Newly added: Building Construction Speedup 5%

5. Optimized layout in Bag to make it easier to find items.

6. Hero balance adjustments for better performance and Might alignment.

7. Fixed several known bugs.

You will be unable to log in during the maintenance, please wait patiently. Thank you for your support and cooperation. Enjoy the game!

# Server Maintenance Notice

This update will take place on UTC 08:00 2026/5/8

I. New Content
1. Frontier Pact
The new "Frontier Pact" will replace the previous "Development Contract"
Note: After the update, the "Development Contract" purchase option will be closed. If you've already purchased the "Development Contract" before the update, you can still complete all quests and claim the corresponding rewards.

II. Hero Gear
1. Hero Gear System Optimization
Gear Promotion: After the update, when Gear reaches Lv.10, Lv.20, Lv.30, and Lv.40, you can consume Blueprints to perform Promotion.
Enhanced Level Cap: Gear enhancement adjusted. After the update, Gear can continue consuming Blueprints for enhancement beyond Lv.40, up to Lv.60.
Note: After this adjustment, the total number of items required for Gear enhancement remains the same as before.

2. Emojis
After the update, you can use emojis in chat.

3. Crystal Cluster Valley
Optimized display of Crystal Cluster Valley gameplay features for better clarity.
Adjusted the mechanism of negative effects after Hero is defeated.
Optimized Valley Awakening Skill effects.
Added Sacred Cave defense win streak announcement system to record and showcase consecutive victories.

III. Bug Fixes
Fixed abnormal Epigraph Might display in certain scenarios.
Fixed several known issues to further improve game stability.

For the latest content and benefits, please join our Discord community.
Thank you for your support and understanding. Enjoy the game!

Last Asylum Team

# Detailed instructions for Hero Skill adjustments

a. Nicole's skill [Ember Dust]: Changed the recovery effect to 10K + 50%.
b. Nicole's skill [Heartwarming Flame]: Adjusted the healing effect.
c. Billy's skill [Truth and Lies]: Changed from applying a "DMG Taken Increase" debuff to the attack target → to applying the debuff to 3 random enemy units.
d. Billy's skill [Puppet]: Increased the bonus effects at 1★ and 2★. The 3★ effect has been changed to: additionally reduces Energy DMG taken by 8%.
e. Daskal's skill [Resolute Fight]: Changed from prioritizing tanks for shields at the start of battle → to granting shields to allied DPS heroes when their HP falls below 50%.

# Update Notes

This update will roll out at 2026/7/30 07:00 UTC

What's New: 
1. Alliance Battle Log: View attack records from Alliance members.
2. Falcon Tower One-Tap Reward Claim unlocks at Lv.8.
3. Event Schedule: Major Events requiring reservation or scheduled activation (Hunt Battle, Cheese Trap, etc.) are now displayed in a unified Event Schedule.

Optimizations: 
1. Raven interface now features separate buttons for Skin and Upgrade Preview.
2. Thief Hunt optimized:
- Lv.80+ Thief Leaders now drop Chief's Coin Chest (awarded to discoverer and Rally initiator).
- Max discoverable Leader level increases after the highest Leader is defeated 3 times by your Alliance.

3. Gold Egg can now be grabbed by tapping the egg directly.
4. Undead Siege interface display optimized.
5. Era Alliance Rankings now displays your Alliance's identifier.
6. Official interface default timezone adjusted to local timezone.
7. Caravan Trade now allows Cross-Server dispatch while viewing status.

8. Elixir Scramble reminder Mail added:
- 4 hours before signup deadline for unregistered Alliances.
- 2 hours before signup deadline for Alliances with fewer than 10 signed up members.

9. Era Specialty Skills optimized:
- Support Skills now jump to Sandbox and auto-select targets.
- War Flag Skills Buffs preview in Buff bar.
- Specialty Skills shareable in chat.
- Support Skills trigger private notifications after use.
- Some Passive Skills are now displayed in Skill Preview panel.
- War Flag usage logic and visual effects optimized.
- Sandbox Skill status display improved, distinguishing learned/active states.
- Assault Battle Frenzy Skill description and effects refined.
- Weakness Skill reworked (now weakens enemy Soldiers by ratio during combat instead of knockback).

Fixes: 
1. Fixed Exclusive Weapon info errors in battle reports under special circumstances.
2. Fixed marching armies being able to attack Demon King Blight.
3. Fixed Era Monster RES display errors under special circumstances.
4. Fixed duplicate Alliance abbreviation prompts across servers on Sandbox.
5. Fixed Hell Doctor redirect failure in Pandemic Experience under special circumstances.
6. Fixed rapid Triangular Arena taps causing double consecutive challenges.
7. Fixed accidentally reset learned Specialty Skills when previewing other classes.
8. Fixed Resource building bubbles not refreshing after Minister of The Inner Court activation.
9. Fixed Error when player name exceeds length limit.

Welcome to share your feedbacks and suggestions about this update in https://discord.com/channels/1417476085179748507/1532199502256148570
